links = edges %>%
  filter(weight >= 80)

frontier = tibble(node = "B32005")
reached = tibble(node = character(), hop = integer())
hop_rows = integer()
hop_kept = integer()
for (hop in 1:2) {
  frontier = frontier %>%
    inner_join(links, by = c("node" = "from"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    select(node = to)
  hop_rows[hop] = nrow(frontier)
  frontier = frontier %>% distinct(node)
  hop_kept[hop] = nrow(frontier)
  reached = bind_rows(reached, tibble(node = frontier$node, hop = hop))
}

g = graph_from_data_frame(links, directed = FALSE, vertices = nodes)
# tidygraph: morph(to_local_neighborhood, node = "B32005", order = 2)
rings = reached %>%
  filter(node != "B32005") %>%
  group_by(node) %>%
  summarize(hop = min(hop)) %>%
  count(hop)
ring = function(h) sum(rings$n[rings$hop == h])

tibble(neighbours = ego_size(g, order = 2, nodes = "B32005", mindist = 1),
       join_rows = sum(hop_rows), kept_rows = sum(hop_kept),
       ring_1 = ring(1), ring_2 = ring(2), ring_3 = ring(3), ring_4 = ring(4),
       rows_1 = hop_rows[1], rows_2 = coalesce(hop_rows[2], 0L),
       rows_3 = coalesce(hop_rows[3], 0L), rows_4 = coalesce(hop_rows[4], 0L))
code.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE walk(node, hop) AS (
  SELECT 'B32005', 0
  UNION
  SELECT e."to", w.hop + 1
  FROM walk w
  JOIN edges e ON e."from" = w.node
  WHERE w.hop < 2 AND e.weight >= 80
)
SELECT COUNT(*) - 1 AS kept_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN node <> 'B32005' THEN node END) AS neighbours
FROM walk;
